subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept the custom yielding glob walker and bootstrap-only handler scheduling as the focused fix despite possible prompt-order and session-timing changes for existing extra-bootstrap configurations?
rationale: The patch targets a source-reproducible P1 stall without changing public SDK signatures, but bootstrap context and hook ordering are compatibility-sensitive session surfaces whose upgrade tradeoff requires owner intent.

options.title: Land After Exact-Head Verification
options.body: Accept the internal ordering and scheduling risk, refresh exact-head checks, and merge the focused bootstrap mitigation.

options.title: Require Live Channel Proof
options.body: Keep the implementation but require a current-head embedded run with active channel or WebSocket latency evidence before merging.

options.title: Pause For Broader Architecture
options.body: Hold or close the PR if owners prefer worker isolation, priority scheduling, or caching instead of maintaining a custom bootstrap walker.

recommendation.title: Land After Exact-Head Verification
recommendation.body: Accept the internal ordering and scheduling risk, refresh exact-head checks, and merge the focused bootstrap mitigation.

likelyOwner.reason: History connects this person to the internal-hook, bootstrap-hook, and guarded workspace-read architecture changed by the PR.
